# W3Calc

> > W3Calc is a comprehensive online calculator platform offering basic arithmetic, scientific computation, and graphing capabilities with Desmos-style visualization tools.

W3Calc provides free web-based calculators for students, educators, and professionals who need quick access to mathematical computation tools without installing software. The platform emphasizes ease of use with multiple calculator modes ranging from simple arithmetic to advanced graphing and equation solving.

## Key Topics

- online calculator
- scientific calculator
- graphing calculator
- basic calculator

## Core Calculators

- [W3 Calculator](https://w3calc.com): Homepage for W3Calc online calculator suite with basic/scientific/graphing
- [Calculator - English](https://w3calc.com/en): Main English calculator page with basic to scientific calculation tools
- [Basic Calculator - English](https://w3calc.com/en/basic): Basic arithmetic calculator for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division
- [Scientific Calculator - English](https://w3calc.com/en/scientific): Scientific calculator with trigonometry, logarithms, and advanced functions
- [Online Calculator - English](https://w3calc.com/en/online): General online calculator with scientific and graphing capabilities

## Graphing & Visualization

- [Desmos Calculator - English](https://w3calc.com/en/desmos): Desmos-style graphing calculator with equation solving and visualization

- [Privacy - W3Calc](https://w3calc.com/privacy): Privacy policy covering data collection, cookies, and user privacy
